exposure.needed: whether operators run `flux events` with the --all-namespaces flag

consequence.statement: Operators who run `flux events` with `--all-namespaces` will now get events from all namespaces instead of the flag being ignored, so the command's output changes for that invocation.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; verify any scripts consuming `flux events --all-namespaces` output, which previously behaved as namespace-scoped.

assertion.statement: The flux `events` command now respects the `--all-namespaces` flag, which it previously ignored.
